text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Still, it really was a surprise. 
Bright, of all people, volunteering to be 
the event coordinator.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I was totally shocked too! 
You've rarely stepped up to lead these 
kinds of events before, haven't you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Indeed. I have usually stayed right by 
dearest Sister Ryan's side. 
That is why this time, I stepped forward 
to try doing it without relying on her.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Standing beside my sister is warm, 
reassuring, and terribly comfortable. 
However, I realized that I cannot simply 
stay nestled in that comfort forever.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
By seeing this role through with my own 
strength, 
I wish to show Sister Ryan just how much I 
have grown~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
—And there is one more thing. I, too, wish 
to bring something new to the Mejiro 
family. 
With that in mind, I chose the 'Mejiro 
Christmas Night.'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: To the Mejiro family...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes. The path I have walked thus far 
exists only because of Sister Ryan and all 
of my Mejiro sisters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Nourished by the history and traditions 
that all of you have built, 
I, too, have been able to carry the Mejiro 
legacy forward.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Just as I have received so much from my 
sisters... 
—I wish to give back something that will 
serve as a cornerstone for the Mejiro 
family.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I want to repay the Mejiro family, 
and most of all, dearest Sister Ryan.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
And so, I have resolved to give it my 
all~. 
Hustle, muscle~~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahaha! The Ryan spirit is alive and 
well! 
Got it, got it. If that's the deal, then 
Palmer-san is gonna give you her full 
support!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: ...Dober?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Um, hey, can I... help out too? With 
organizing.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Ryan's taken care of me just as much. 
Repaying her... I want to do that too, you 
know...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I had a feeling you would say that. 
Let us repay her together, Dober.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
! Thank you, both of you...! 
I'll do my best to be of help!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
—Welcome to the 1st 'Mejiro Christmas 
Night' Planning Meeting~~! 
Let's gooo!! Take it away, Bright!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Yes~. I would like to enrich the greeting 
time between our fans and the Mejiro 
Umamusume~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
With small groups centered around the 
theme of 'intimate interaction with 
Umamusume,' 
I hope to create a meet-and-greet that 
feels truly special~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
As for the venue... how about an amusement 
park~?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
An amusement park sounds awesome! We can 
go all out with Christmas decorations! 
It'll feel super special, and the photos 
will be insanely aesthetic!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
According to the surveys, fan satisfaction 
was really high for the meet-and-greets. 
Expanding on that sounds like a great 
idea.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Plus, there's the turnout rate. Rather 
than renting out a hotel or event hall, 
amusement parks and resorts tend to draw 
much bigger crowds.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ooh~! Even data analysis?! 
You're insanely motivated!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it is simply the fundamentals~. Sister 
Ryan always told me that analyzing data is 
crucial, after all~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
'Measured stats are the voice of your 
muscles. 
You can't build a workout routine while 
neglecting data!' Right?

text_block_list.name: Bright & Dober
text_block_list.text:
'Numbers are muscle! Muscle is numbers! 
She who masters the numbers, masters the 
muscles!!'

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Ahahahaha! Good girl, putting her 
teachings to great use♪ 
I mean, that's Ryan for ya!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Alright, since we've got the data to back 
it up, 
let's officially adopt Bright's idea—

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
What are your thoughts, Lady Palmer? 
I would love to hear your proposal as 
well~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Huh? I don't really have anything... 
You know I'm usually just a support 
player! 
I figured that's what I'd be doing this 
time, too!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Besides, I only join Christmas Night every 
now and then, anyway. 
My input wouldn't be much help.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
...It is precisely because of who you are, 
Lady Palmer, that I invited you to be an 
event coordinator, you know?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
I mentioned that I wish to bring something 
new to the Mejiro family, did I not? 
That 'something'—is new fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
The history and tradition of the Mejiro 
family carry immense weight. 
Yet, perhaps because of that very weight, 
we currently struggle to attract new fans.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
You, Lady Palmer, are a free spirit who is 
unbound by Mejiro tradition. 
You know the world outside the Mejiro 
family far better than anyone.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, I believed you could reach new 
fans in ways that I could never even 
fathom~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
No way, wouldn't doing things my way 
totally shock the old-school Mejiro fans?!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to worry about that~. 
After all, you have me here, and I cherish 
the Mejiro traditions dearly.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
If we blend your ideas together with 
mine... 
I feel we can create an excitement like 
nothing ever seen before~♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I think you'll do fine too. 
After all, Palmer... you were raised in 
the Mejiro family, and you're a Mejiro 
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Dober is quite right. We are all lights of 
the Mejiro family. 
Though our radiance may differ, is not 
every one of us a child of Mejiro's light?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Our own... light...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(...Light... The radiance that I give off 
is—)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
(Lit up by my sun... 
A brilliance that I can finally shine—my 
own light, huh?)

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
...Aha, that's... something I might 
actually want to show off.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Sorry! Could you give me a little more 
time? 
If I'm gonna do this, I want to properly 
think of something only I can do!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Bright
text_block_list.text:
Of course. 
I shall eagerly look forward to your 
proposal, Palmer-sama~.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text:
Thanks, Bright. You too, Dober. 
...Heheh. Time for Mejiro Palmer to show 
'em what she's got!
